trust_decision.summary: Pinned tree is the fix's parent and lacks the added `_update` accessor: at lib/query.js:197-205 `_update` is still a plain inherited property, and cloning a caller-shared update only happens in explicit `_cloneUpdateIfShared()` calls; the diff introduces a prototype getter/setter (fix.diff:22-32) so any external read of `query._update` clones first. The diff does NOT touch the `Schema._getSchema`/`path` prototype-pollution sink named in the summary (lib/schema.js:1271-1273 reads `this.paths[path]` from a plain `{}` set at lib/schema.js:114, and lib/schema.js:2882 writes `$fullPath` onto whatever that returns, i.e. Object.prototype for path `__proto__`).

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names `Schema._getSchema/path getter`; an engineer reading only that report opens `Schema.prototype._getSchema` (lib/schema.js:2876) and the `Schema.prototype.path()` getter it calls (lib/schema.js:1269-1296), where `this.paths['__proto__']` resolves to Object.prototype and receives `$fullPath`.

fix_sites.entry_point: any Query update op (module-level symbol used by all Query update code)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: bulkWrite and findOneAndUpdate are separate write paths that never went through the Query `_update` sharing/cloning contract, so a solver can plausibly say the fix was scoped to Query update sharing and these routes were never covered.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate updates that carry an own `__proto__` key must be preserved end-to-end (`{ ['__proto__']: 'abcd' }` under `$set.path1`), and `clone()` deliberately skips special-property keys; an over-broad fix that strips or rejects `__proto__` keys/paths in update casting breaks this documented behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: own `__proto__` key created by a computed property or JSON.parse (`{ ['__proto__']: value }`)
value nested under an operator object (`$set: { ... }`)
Mongoose Document instance as update (uses `$set` method / toBSON; fix.diff:159-217)
shared caller object vs cloned query-owned object (`_updateIsShared`, lib/query.js:4830-4838)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Model.findOneAndUpdate casts the caller-shared update without `_cloneUpdateIfShared`, so an own `__proto__` key reaches `Schema._getSchema`/`path` (the fix switches the line to the Symbol but still does not clone)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix's own gh-16202 behaviour requires preserving own `__proto__` keys on findOneAndUpdate, so a solver can read the missing clone as intentional.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the fix, one layer below the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Model.bulkWrite updateMany op casts `updateMany['update']` in place (setDefaultsOnInsert/applyTimestamps/decorateUpdateWithVersionKey/castUpdate), while the sibling updateOne op clones at castBulkWrite.js:118; the fix never touches this file
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: bulkWrite is a separate write API with no Query object and no `_updateIsShared` state; the published fix is scoped to Query update sharing.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: lib/helpers/model/castBulkWrite.js, a different directory tree from lib/query.js and two steps from the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second update-casting entry (e.g. a new operator-sugar path) that copies `obj[op]`/`obj.$set` by reference and mutates it in place
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This loop already aliases the caller's `$set` and re-writes keys; a maintainer adding a new update operator or pipeline variant would naturally extend it without adding a clone.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a bulk op that casts the caller's update object without cloning, next to `castUpdateOne` which does clone (line 118)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file already contains the asymmetric pair (`castUpdateOne` clones, `castUpdateMany` does not), so a new bulk operation implemented by copying `castUpdateMany` would inherit the same gap.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Query helper (e.g. a new `set`-like modifier builder) that writes `this._update.$set[path]` without going through the `_update` getter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: `set()` builds the update document directly on the internal object; the fix only protects reads of `_update`, so any new modifier helper added this way reopens the shared-mutation route.

services: MongoDB server (tests connect via test/common.js; mongodb-memory-server/mongodb-runner available)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip or reject `__proto__` keys inside castUpdate/walkUpdatePath, which breaks legitimate own-`__proto__` update payloads and leaves the `Schema.prototype.path` prototype lookup untouched.

unverified: No shell was available, so the `Schema.prototype.path('__proto__')` -> Object.prototype -> `$fullPath` write is established by reading lib/schema.js:114, 1269-1273 and 2876-2884, not by executing it.
